# telnyx_user_tags (Data Source)

The account's tags on phone numbers and outbound voice profiles.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `number_tags` (List of String) A list of your tags on the given resource type. NOTE: The casing of the tags returned will not necessarily match the casing of the tags when they were added to a resource. This is because the tags will have the casing of the first time they were used within the Telnyx system regardless of source.
- `outbound_profile_tags` (List of String) A list of your tags on the given resource type. NOTE: The casing of the tags returned will not necessarily match the casing of the tags when they were added to a resource. This is because the tags will have the casing of the first time they were used within the Telnyx system regardless of source.
